purpose: Evaluate a market-independent, race-coherent wide probability baseline derived only from Ability Top3 marginals before any M3/P10/RPCI residual correction or Production use.

model.name: fixed_size_maximum_entropy_top3
model.definition: For every 3-horse subset S, P(S) = exp(sum(theta_i for i in S)) / Z, with theta solved so each horse's marginal inclusion probability equals Ability Top3.
model.wide_probability: q_ij = sum(P(S) for S containing i and j)

offline_reconstruction_note: Metrics below were reconstructed from the locally supplied TARGET-style historical CSVs using the current Ability formula/history policy. The reconstructed race counts differ slightly from the frozen ability_model_v1 official OOS counts, so these results are a directional Shadow gate, not Production promotion evidence.
interpretation: The coherent transform materially improves probability quality and calibration versus multiplying marginal Top3 probabilities.
AUC/ranking is essentially unchanged; this is expected because v1 is a probability-coherence layer, not a new horse-ranking signal.
This makes the model suitable as a baseline for later EV research, but not yet a validated BUY rule.
Any M3/P10/RPCI/Queue correction must be tested as a separate pre-race residual model with race-grouped year splits and must preserve race coherence.
Market odds must remain outside the structural probability model and be applied only afterward for decision-time EV evaluation.

next_gate.uncertainty: Use race-level clustered/bootstrap comparisons, not pair-level independent standard errors.
next_gate.promotion_rule: Do not connect to Production until structural residual corrections and decision-time wide-odds EV are frozen and pass OOS/forward validation.
